notes: Seed https://www.co.mcculloch.tx.us/ loads; ELECTION INFO page lists results (some files on newtools.cira.state.tx.us). No Clarity site (elections.json 404). Only county cumulative reports are posted for the three elections, each uploaded the morning or day after election night (Last-Modified differs per file). No precinct reports for any target election (the county did post a precinct report for the March 2022 primary). Rule 43 applied 2026-10-02 (normalize-2): 2024_general LATER kept, county_totals_first_seen 2024-11-05 21:03 CT; 2026_primary LATER to UNDETERMINED; 2026_runoff LATER kept, county_totals_first_seen 2026-05-26 20:28 CT. 2026_primary: the only primary file is 'Cumulative Results-3-4-2026 08-15-34 AM' (printed Run Time 8:15 AM, CreationDate Mar 4 14:15 UTC), after election night.
tag_rationale: Results: 2024_general LATER, 2026_primary UNDETERMINED, 2026_runoff LATER. Two or more elections share the result that maps to COUNTY_ONLY_PRECINCT_AT_CANVASS, so the rule gives COUNTY_ONLY_PRECINCT_AT_CANVASS. (Recomputed under Rule 43, 2026-10-02.)
